summary: heavy with advertising or profiling trackers, not from a store
reason: com.cleaner.turbo contains 1 tracker kit (Adbrix) and did not come from an app store. Five or more advertising trackers, or a profiling tracker, in an app installed outside a store is the pattern of adware.
remediation: If you do not need com.cleaner.turbo, uninstall it. If you do, expect it to sell what you do inside it.
label: Adware heavy
cardText: Contains 1 advertising or profiling trackers that sell what you do.
